description: Paint first, confirm after (docs/message-sync.md#painting-from-the-store and #opening-at-a-position). `paint`: a room or thread opened for the first time this run reads its stored window and asks the relay at the same time; whichever answers first is drawn. `store` is what the store read returns (`rows`, `empty`, `fails`), `first` which side answers first, `relay` how the relay request ends (`ok`, `fails`). Expect: `draws` = the first window drawn (`stored`, `relay`, or `error`), `then` = what replaces a stored window (`relay` or null), `relay_requests` = relay requests sent for the open, including the refresh that follows a stored paint. Painting never depends on the connection or on the room's live subscription having loaded, and a painted window never counts as a fetched (current) window. `anchor`: where the open lands, decided on the rows held, stored or not. `rows` are the loaded top-level rows oldest first (`[id, created_at]`), `has_older` whether older pages exist, `frontier` the read marker (null: never read), `first_unread` the first unread top-level row among them, `remembered` the reading position kept for the room (null: none), `current` whether the rows are a window fetched during this visit. Expect `open` (a row id, or null for the newest) or `seek: true` (ask the relay for older pages first; the only case that shows loading), and `provisional` (decided on rows that are not current; may be moved once). `reanchor`: a provisional decision and the decision the same rule gives once the relay's window is shown; the open moves (or seeks older pages, `seek: true`) only when the reader has not scrolled. `paint_gap`: whether a store paint may decide at all. `complete_from` is how far back the store holds the room's events without a gap (null: unknown), `first_unread` the first unread top-level row's time among the painted rows (null: none), `frontier` the read marker (null: never read); a thread passes `read_before` (the time of the newest read reply before the first unread one, null when it is the oldest loaded) and `has_older` instead of `frontier`. Expect `decides` (false: the open waits for the relay's window). Desktop: desktop/src/features/messages/lib/storeRoomHead.ts, desktop/src/features/channels/lib/openAnchorDecision.ts; mobile: to follow.

paint.name: stored rows draw at once, then the relay's window replaces them
a relay answer before the store read is drawn instead
nothing stored waits for the relay
a failed store read waits for the relay
a relay failure before the store answers still draws the stored rows
a relay failure with nothing stored is an error

anchor.name: stored rows reaching the read marker open at the first unread on the first frame
stored rows that are all unread with older history ask the relay for older pages
stored rows that are all unread and the whole history open at the first unread
nothing unread opens at the remembered row when it is stored
a remembered row older than the stored rows is sought
nothing unread and no remembered row open at the newest
a room never read opens at the newest
a current window decides for good

reanchor.name: the relay brings a first unread the store lacked: move there
a reader who scrolled is not moved
the relay agrees with the stored rows: nothing moves
a row only older pages could find is sought before the open moves
a reader who scrolled is not moved to seek either

paint_gap.name: a room held without a gap since the read marker decides
a hole between yesterday's read marker and today's rows waits for the relay
unknown coverage with an unread row waits for the relay
nothing unread among the painted rows decides
a room never read decides (it opens at the newest)
thread: held since the newest read reply decides
thread: a hole after the newest read reply waits for the relay
thread: the oldest loaded reply unread with older pages decides (older pages are sought)
thread: the oldest stored reply unread without a whole history waits
